limitations: B01: measured monthly energy only for 2024-01..2025-10 (study workbook, sheet 8.ELOR) with the peak split from same-year Office peers; 2025-11/12 are modeled from B01 2025 months. B_01.csv is project-generated and excluded.

B01 2023 (training year) is a declared backcast: 2024 measured monthly profile x 0.98 (original method). It uses validation-year information; its months carry cross_year_leakage_declared and a sensitivity excluding modeled buildings is required.
Missing months are modeled within the same year; hourly shapes are generated from registry schedules, not measured.

TOU registers differing from the printed total by >2 % are scaled to the printed total (owner rule); printed totals outside 0.5..2 x the registers are treated as transcription errors and the registers kept (flagged).
Weather is NASA POWER reanalysis for one grid point, not a local station.
PEN/USD uses the annual official average (World Bank); monthly variation is not represented.
TotalFacturado is assumed to be in PEN and includes non-energy charges; the peak/off-peak price ratio 0.38/0.26 is a project assumption.
Carbon intensity is one constant: IPCC 2006 gas/diesel oil factor over an assumed 0.40 plant efficiency.

PV and BESS are a declared design scenario sized by the MicroGrids LP with assumed economics; export is credited at the purchase price (net billing, not available in Iquitos today) and nothing is curtailed; the PV bound is the covered built area, not a roof survey.
EV: only a declared 2-motorcycle pilot at B01; all other buildings have no EV and no charger.
Controlled machine energy, cooling design COP and schedules are assumptions carried from the earlier tools.
